reason: The combined SACP (Skill-Agent Control Plane) + Managed-Patch-Preservation v2 integration sprint touches 68 protected files across all five LawFirm OS repos. Changes are: (a) additions of new governance/registry/schema/validator files, (b) bootstrap-block augmentations prepended to existing AGENTS.md and AI_WORK_START_HERE.md files (original content preserved in REPO_SPECIFIC_INSTRUCTIONS blocks), (c) replacement of v1 validator/test with v2 (covered by individual decision records), (d) contracts.lock.json SHA bump (covered by individual decision record), (e) schema-surface-exclusions.json updated to enumerate SACP schemas, (f) LKR AI_WORK_START_HERE.md reconstructed after it was deleted by a prior apply step, (g) per-repo .gitignore additions for backup/noise patterns, (h) SKILL_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_BOUNDARY.md extended with the schema-surface exclusion rule paragraph.
user_intent_alignment_summary: The user's task objective for this sprint is to apply the LawFirm-os-managed-patch-preservation-gate-patch-v2 workspace-wide and close the five blockers/hardening gaps from the prior architecture review. The broad blast radius is inherent to a workspace-wide governance integration: every repo in the LawFirm OS kernel must register with the Skill-Agent Control Plane, receive a skill-agent-manifest.json, and update its AI entry points. Narrow patches cannot fulfill this objective.
diff_review_summary: 68 protected files changed across 5 repos. By category: (1) AGENTS.md + AI_WORK_START_HERE.md in all 5 repos (bootstrap blocks added, original content preserved in REPO_SPECIFIC_INSTRUCTIONS wrapper); (2) New files added: skill-agent-manifest.json in all 5 repos, governance docs in substrate and per-repo docs/, schema files in substrate schemas/, registry files in substrate registry/, scripts and tests in substrate scripts/ and tests/; (3) Existing files replaced under individual decision records: validator, test suite, contracts.lock.json, LKR AGENTS.md; (4) schema-surface-exclusions.json updated (pre-existing file, not a net removal); (5) LKR AI_WORK_START_HERE.md reconstructed from bootstrap template after deletion; (6) Per-repo .gitignore extended with backup/noise patterns; (7) SKILL_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_BOUNDARY.md extended with schema-surface exclusion rule. No runtime code paths in src/ were modified. All original content preserved either in-file (REPO_SPECIFIC_INSTRUCTIONS block), as .skill-agent-control-backup, or as .managed-preservation-backup. Managed-patch decision records are normal untracked files. registry/managed-patch-decisions/** is excluded only from blast-radius count/digest; explicit plain git add <paths> works, and no force-add is required.
alternatives_considered: Stage the integration as a series of smaller per-repo patches applied in separate sessions. Rejected because the SACP and managed-patch-preservation v2 are interdependent: the v2 validator requires SACP registries and manifests to check the workspace; splitting them would leave the workspace in a partial state where the validator catches violations it cannot yet resolve.

Apply only the v2 managed-patch-preservation gate without the SACP integration. Rejected because the prior session (before this handoff) had already applied both patches; unwinding the SACP changes would require reverting completed, verified work.
